short: The exact Hausdorff gauge of SLE

title.title: Exact Hausdorff gauges for SLE
title.subtitle: Claim: $r^d(\log\log 1/r)^{(2-d)/2}$ is the exact Hausdorff gauge of $\mathrm{SLE}_\kappa$, $d = 1 + \kappa/8$

lines.note: positive and finite measure on every curve segment

beats.text: Schramm asked which gauge makes their Hausdorff measure a true length
Claim: this one, with an iterated-log correction

achievement.label: Schramm's problem (2006 list, Problem 7.1)

achievement.note: Not the exponent-one iterated-log gauge Schramm suggested

plain: A random fractal curve is too wiggly for ordinary length; which exact ruler gives it a finite, nonzero size?

voice.text: These random curves are fractals, too wiggly for ordinary length.
Schramm asked which exact measuring rule gives them a true length.
Claimed: a power with an iterated log correction.
Lean covers only the positive half.
